title: Herding Cats
content: So often in my dreams I find myself trying to gather up tons of cats. My cats plus the stray cats I have taken in when dreaming. Now there are like 30 cats and night after night of my regular mall world dreams I am trying to gather them all up and save them. Last night I had them all gathered up into a vehicle and then everyone opened the doors. So I had to do it again. Things are getting way scary in my dream world lately. Apocalyptic. I wish I didn’t have to also herd cats.
